name: scaffold
title: Set up a project
summary: Ask the agent to create or adapt folders, project guidance, and runnable commands for a new piece of work.
requirements: Filesystem access. Git and language-specific setup tools are used when the project needs them.
prompt:
/dss-agent-skills:scaffold
Create a paper project for a study of school attendance. Propose a suitable layout, preserve any existing files, and ask about missing research decisions.
outcomes: Selects a supplied template or adapts a bundled example.
Creates the agreed folder structure and project context files.
Checks that the resulting layout and commands fit the project.

steps: Choose or adapt a project template.
Create the agreed folders and context files.
Check the layout and runnable commands.
library.example: Set up a paper project for a study of school attendance.

name: review-plan
title: Review a research plan
summary: Find consequential gaps, unsupported assumptions, and missing checks before committing to the work.
requirements: A plan or proposal. A separate reviewer session is needed for an independent review.
prompt:
/dss-agent-skills:review-plan analysis-plan.md
Review whether this plan can answer the research question with the available data. Identify the most consequential gaps and explain how to address them.
outcomes: Reads the plan against its stated goals and applicable project conventions.
Uses a fresh reviewer when the host supports one and reports the isolation achieved.
Writes a review brief separating demonstrated problems, alternatives, and open questions.

steps: Read the plan against its research goals.
Arrange an independent review when supported.
Report consequential gaps and ways to address them.
library.example: Review whether this analysis plan can answer the research question.

name: dag
title: Draw a causal diagram
summary: Turn a supplied causal graph into a clear figure, with adjustment sets checked against the graph.
requirements: R with dagitty; XeLaTeX with TikZ and standalone; a PDF rasterizer or viewer.
prompt:
/dss-agent-skills:dag study.dag --exposure heat --outcome birthweight
Check the available adjustment sets and render a figure from this graph. Preserve the causal structure.
outcomes: Identifies exposure, outcome, and other node roles from the supplied graph.
Computes adjustment sets with dagitty and distinguishes alternatives.
Builds and inspects a PDF, refining labels and connections.

steps: Read the supplied causal graph.
Check adjustment sets with dagitty.
Draw and inspect the figure without changing the graph.
library.example: Draw this causal diagram and check its adjustment sets.

name: litsearch
title: Find research literature
summary: Keep the queries, screening decisions, reading limits, and citation checks behind a literature search.
requirements: Python 3.9+ and permitted access to the selected literature sources. Full-text availability depends on your access.
prompt:
/dss-agent-skills:litsearch
Find studies of maternal heat exposure and birthweight. Start with OpenAlex, Crossref, and PubMed. Record the search scope, screening decisions, and whether each paper was read in full or only as an abstract.
outcomes: Records the research question, search scope, queries, and retrieved responses.
Screens retrieved papers and assembles an evidence table.
Checks citation metadata and saves BibTeX and RIS bibliographies.

steps: Record the question, sources, and queries.
Screen papers and build an evidence table.
Verify citations and save the bibliography.
library.example: Find studies of maternal heat exposure and birthweight.

name: eda
title: Explore a dataset
summary: Generate a first-look report on distributions, missing values, and relationships worth investigating.
requirements: R and Quarto, the R packages listed in the bundled template, and XeLaTeX for PDF output.
prompt:
/dss-agent-skills:eda data/birth-records.csv outcome=birthweight exposures=hot_days grouping=smoking
Create an exploratory report and flag data-quality issues that need investigation.
outcomes: Checks that the input and named variables can be read.
Builds an exploratory report using the supplied Quarto template.
Reports the output location, included sections, and any failures that need attention.

steps: Check the data and named variables.
Build a report from the Quarto template.
Flag data-quality issues and report any failures.
library.example: Explore birthweight, hot-day exposure, and missing values.

name: review-analysis
title: Review an analysis
summary: Check whether analysis code follows the scientific requirements and supports the quantities it reports.
requirements: Analysis code, its scientific specification, and available saved evidence. A separate reviewer session is needed for an independent review.
prompt:
/dss-agent-skills:review-analysis code/
Review this analysis against the project specification. Check the reported contrasts, uncertainty calculations, diagnostics, and reproducibility. Do not change or run the analysis.
outcomes: Traces the implementation against the research requirements.
Examines statistical choices, relevant causal assumptions, and saved diagnostics.
Writes findings with evidence and limitations; a static review does not establish that code runs correctly.

steps: Compare the code with the research specification.
Check statistical choices and saved diagnostics.
Report findings, evidence, and limits of the review.
library.example: Review the analysis against its specification without running or changing it.

name: targets
title: Build a repeatable R pipeline
summary: Organize an R analysis into stages so completed, unchanged work can be reused when the pipeline runs again.
requirements: R with targets; crew for parallel workers when needed. Uses the project's existing software environment.
prompt:
/dss-agent-skills:targets
Turn the data preparation, model fitting, and figure generation into a targets pipeline. Make the input files explicit dependencies and check which stages rerun after a figure-only change.
outcomes: Defines independently runnable stages with explicit dependencies.
Runs and inspects the pipeline using the project's environment.
Diagnoses unnecessary reruns and explains what can resume after interruption.

steps: Define stages and their dependencies.
Run and inspect the pipeline.
Check what reruns after a change or interruption.
library.example: Build a targets pipeline for data preparation, models, and figures.

name: pueue
title: Queue computational jobs
summary: Let independent computational jobs run with controlled concurrency while the agent tracks progress and outcomes.
requirements: The Pueue client and a running daemon; jq for the illustrated status queries. Each job needs its own working environment.
prompt:
/dss-agent-skills:pueue
Queue the project's simulation commands with two concurrent jobs. Save their IDs and check the logs and expected output files before reporting completion.
outcomes: Prepares commands with explicit working directories and environments.
Submits the authorized jobs and records their queue IDs.
Checks actual outcomes, distinguishing a finished queue entry from verified output.

steps: Prepare commands and working environments.
Submit authorized jobs and record their IDs.
Check logs and expected output files.
library.example: Queue the simulation commands with two jobs running at a time.

name: review-prose
title: Review prose for clarity
summary: Find passages readers have to decode and assess proposed revisions in the surrounding paragraph.
requirements: Python 3.9+ for the supplied detector and a Markdown or plain-text draft.
prompt:
/dss-agent-skills:review-prose manuscript.md
Review the prose for clarity. Explain why each consequential passage is difficult to read and propose a clearer version without editing the manuscript.
outcomes: Scans for selected patterns associated with unclear or overly compressed prose.
Reviews each hit in context, discarding false positives.
Reports proposed revisions for the author to consider.

steps: Scan the draft for potentially unclear passages.
Read each passage in context.
Explain the problem and propose a clearer version.
library.example: Review this manuscript for clarity and propose revisions.
